title: About viggo.games
intro: is a collection of browser and mobile games made by Viggo, built for fun, learning, and a bit of arcade nostalgia.
story: All games are designed and developed by Viggo with a little help from his dad and Codex. Play for free in a modern browser with no download required, or enjoy Chicken Hop, Hunter Guy, Burb, and Gunny in the Viggo Games mobile app.
